findings.label: Missing resolveUrl property in listing-detail
findings.detail: listing-detail.component.ts imports resolveUrl and uses it in openExternalUrl() but does not expose it as a class property. The template currently uses a button click handler so nothing breaks today, but it diverges from every other component in this change. Any future [href]="resolveUrl(l.listingUrl)" added to the template would silently bind to undefined at runtime. Add readonly resolveUrl = resolveUrl; to match the established pattern.

findings.label: Protocol-relative URL edge case in resolveUrl()
findings.detail: A value like //example.com does not start with http:// or https://, so resolveUrl() prepends https:// and produces https:////example.com — a malformed URL. Production listing data is unlikely to contain protocol-relative strings, but a guard for trimmed.startsWith('//') returning `https:${trimmed}` would close the gap without side effects.
